content:
rachel: hey team, day 1 questions — I need access to the AWS Dedicated account (assume-role style) and GCP project 'redwood-private-eu' for deployments in europe-west1. Also need billing view on redwood-eu-billing. Who should I ping and what's the usual turnaround?

devon: welcome! ping @infra for the AWS assume-role (we use cross-account role 'Redwood-DedicatedAccess'). For GCP billing, open a finance ticket. Turnaround is usually same-day if 2FA + security key is enrolled.

rachel: thanks. do I need any special service-account permissions to deploy? and if we need GPUs in eu-west1, who requests quota?

infra: infra here. For deploys we bind 'roles/iam.serviceAccountUser' on the platform-deploy SA. For GPUs, submit a regional quota increase in GCP Console and cc @cloud-sre. We will also add the AWS trust policy for your user once you’re in the SSO group.

finance-bot: Please file a billing access request: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/BillingRequest. Use the Billing Access template and include your email, team, projects, and reason. Expected SLA: 1-2 business days.

rachel: perfect. can someone confirm the exact AWS role ARN and the GCP SA email so I can include them in the ticket?

devon: AWS role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-DedicatedAccess. GCP SA: platform-deploy@redwood-private.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

infra: quick note: we enforce security key + 2FA before granting cross-account roles. If you need help enrolling, ping me and I’ll walk you through it.

rachel: I enrolled my security key this morning and filed the billing ticket. tagging infra/cloud-sre on the quota request if we need more GPUs in eu-west1. thanks!
